(4 matches) | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Super League Greece 2|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Super League Greece 2|2027–28]] | updated = 14 October 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Super League 2''', also known as '''Superbet League 2''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/i-super-league-2-metonomastike-episima-se-superbet-league-2/|title=Η Super League 2 μετονομάστηκε επίσημα σε Superbet League 2|date=3 July 2026|lang=el|location=Online}} is the eighth season of the [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]], the second-tier Greek professional league for association football clubs, since the restructuring of the [[Greek football league system]]. The championship began on 5 September 2026 with the 1st round of the regular season.{{cite web|url=https://sl2.gr/?p=10207|title=ΑΠΟΦΑΣΕΙΣ ΣΥΝΕΔΡΙΑΣΗΣ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΟΥ ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΙΟΥ SUPER LEAGUE 2|date=30 April 2026|language=el}} The draw for the fixtures and the whole schedule of the season took place on 28 August 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/podosfairo/SuperLeague2/Super-League-2-brike-neo-xorigo-%E2%80%93-stis-28-augoustou-i-klirwsi/5133754|title=Superbet League 2 Βρήκε νέο χορηγό η Super League 2 – Στις 28 Αυγούστου η κλήρωση|date=3 July 2026|language=el}} Liga S.A. is the official match ball supplier with the '''VENOM''' model.{{cite web|url=https://sl2.gr/?p=10263|title=ΑΠΟΦΑΣΕΙΣ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΟΥ ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΙΟΥ SUPER LEAGUE 2 02/07/2026|date=2 July 2026|language=el}} ==Teams== The following clubs have changed divisions in the last season championships. {{Cite web |title=Super League 2: Οι 16 ομάδες της σεζόν 2026/27 |url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/super-league-2-oi-16-omades-tis-sezon-2026-27/ |access-date=2026-06-04 |website=sport24.gr |language=el-gr}} {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} {{col-2}} ===From Super League Greece 2=== '''Promoted to [[2026–27 Super League Greece|Super League 1]]''' * [[Iraklis F.C. Zakynthos|Zakynthos]] * [[PAS Pyrgos 1968|PAS Pyrgos]] {{col-end}} ===Format=== The championship is being held with 16 teams in one group in one phase, where each team will face all opponents twice home and away, a total of 30 matches in the unified Group, after the further reduction of the teams from last year without play-offs for the promotion and play-outs for the relegation.{{cite web|url=https://sl2.gr/?p=10299|title=ΑΠΟΦΑΣΕΙΣ ΣΥΝΕΔΡΙΑΣΗΣ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΟΥ ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΙΟΥ 15-7-2026|date=15 July 2026|language=el}} For fifth consecutive year, [[PAOK B]] competes and for third consecutive year, Asteras Tripolis B and [[Olympiacos F.C. B|Olympiacos B]] for second. B teams are eligible for relegation but not for promotion. ===Promotion and Relegation=== The top two teams after the conclusion of the championship will be promoted to [[Super League Greece|Super League 1]] and the last four will be relegated to [[Gamma Ethniki]].{{cite
